author: Jiageng
html: Hi Amelia! I'm an Applied Mathematics student at UCLA and I really enjoy reading your series of posts. I was wondering whether you would mind writing another one on your research project, by any chance?

author: Amelia McNamara
html: Depends on how you count it. If you include my tuition + health insurance + stipend, I think closer to 50k. But just the stipend I think is about 30k.

author: Amelia McNamara
html: Now that I'm a visiting assistant professor at Smith, I haven't been blogging as much. But, you might be interested in my dissertation (http://www.science.smith.edu/~amcnamara/dissertation.html) or this page with thoughts on the future of statistical programming (http://www.science.smith.edu/~amcnamara/FoSP.html). Thanks for your interest!

author: Jack
html:
Amelia,

You could write about the job market for statisticians.
How is the is statistics job market? How does it work?
How much does a statistics professor make? Does that change much from school to school?
Since you are working now, it doesn't have to be a big post. I am sure a post like that would help a lot of people.

Best.
